# LUYA Projects

> Turnkey contract furniture manufacturer & architectural joinery partner in Istanbul, Turkey (fixed millwork + loose FF&E for hotels, restaurants, luxury villas, retail fit-out, corporate HQs).

## Core Languages
- English: https://luyaprojects.com/en/
- Turkish: https://luyaprojects.com/tr/
- Arabic: https://luyaprojects.com/ar/
- Russian: https://luyaprojects.com/ru/
